Portfolio case study

Translating jewelry design into launch-ready storytelling.

The problem

Early-stage jewelry concepts often have material and visual direction, but not a concise narrative that can guide a product page, campaign, or customer conversation.

The response

Jewelry Story Kit turns a short design brief into a connected set of marketing directions—without losing the language of material, form, and inspiration.

Audience

Independent jewelry designers, emerging brands, and creative marketers planning a product or collection launch.

Core decisions

  • Start with the designer’s existing vocabulary
  • Make the first useful output immediate
  • Connect product copy to campaign and email language
  • Use a calm editorial interface that keeps focus on the piece
